text: Eating well, moving your body, and getting enough rest are the building blocks of a healthy life. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives you steady energy throughout the day. Regular exercise—even a brisk thirty-minute walk—strengthens your heart and lifts your mood. Equally important is sleep; most adults need seven to nine hours each night to recharge both body and mind. But healthy living isn't only physical. Mental health matters, too, so take time to relax, talk to friends, or practice mindfulness. Finally, strive for a work-life balance by setting boundaries and making room for hobbies. Small, consistent choices like these create a happier, more energetic you.
